health_db_path.description: Read-only SQLite path produced by xiaomi-sync (usually .../data/health.db)

operit_base_url.description: Phone Operit external HTTP base URL

operit_token.description: Bearer token for Operit external HTTP service

control_backend.description: Product mode: app = AstrBot Phone Agent App own frontend with structured Shizuku commands; operit = OperitAI natural-language bridge. Legacy aliases phone_buddy and operitai are accepted. adb is diagnostic-only.

app_shared_token.description: Shared bearer token between this plugin and the AstrBot Phone Agent App app (control_backend=app)

app_direct_urls.description: Comma-separated ordered App endpoints, e.g. http://phone-lan.example:8260,http://phone-tailnet.example:8260. Configured endpoints precede registration.

app_command_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for one structured command sent to the AstrBot Phone Agent App app

app_aliases_json.description: Optional JSON map of friendly app names to Android package names

sleep_guard_exempt_apps.description: Apps excluded from on-demand temporary policies

audit_log_path.description: Local metadata-only action audit log. Relative paths are resolved below AstrBot's managed plugin data directory.

policy_state_path.description: Persistent app-policy state used to restore temporary restrictions after restart

adb_full_port_scan.description: Scan all TCP ports when recovering optional ADB diagnostics

allowed_user_ids.description: Comma-separated AstrBot user IDs allowed to invoke phone actions

use_private_companion_auth.description: Optional: use Private Companion authorization when allowlist is empty

sleep_guard_packages.description: Comma-separated app aliases or package names for on-demand temporary policies (empty disables the default list)

relay_base_url.description: Public relay base URL (deploy/relay) used when Operit over Tailscale is unreachable, e.g. http://[240e:...]:8888/phone-relay

relay_token.description: Shared bearer token for the relay queue

enable_health_tools.description: Enable phone_health tool and /health route (requires xiaomi-sync health.db)

tasks_path.description: Persistent metadata file for background Operit tasks

enable_observe_tool.description: Enable phone_observe, which asks Operit to inspect the current app and screen

enable_usage_tool.description: Enable phone_usage tool (reads Android app usage through Operit)

enable_policy_tools.description: Enable phone_app_policy, phone_sleep_mode, /app_policy and /sleep_mode, plus suspend actions in phone_action

enable_screenshot_tool.description: Enable phone_screenshot: capture the phone screen in App mode and send the picture into the conversation

enable_notification_tool.description: Enable phone_notifications and the /app/notifications route that the App forwards notifications to

notification_path.description: Persistent store for notifications forwarded by the App (contains notification text)

enable_night_guard.description: Enable the deterministic night guard: observe the foreground app during the night window, send one private-chat reminder, then suspend the still-watched video package after a grace period. All actions are audited; dry-run is the safe first deployment.

night_guard_start.description: Night window start time, HH:MM local time. A start later than the end crosses midnight, e.g. 00:30-08:00.

night_guard_end.description: Night window end time, HH:MM local time.

night_guard_check_interval_seconds.description: How often the night guard observes the foreground app, from 60 to 3600 seconds.

night_guard_status_max_age_seconds.description: Foreground status older than this is stale and never triggers a warning or suspension, from 30 to 600 seconds.

night_guard_grace_minutes.description: Minutes between the reminder and the re-check that decides suspension, from 1 to 120.

night_guard_suspend_minutes.description: Automatic restore delay after a night-guard suspension, from 5 to 480 minutes. 0 restores when the night window ends.

night_guard_consecutive_hits.description: Consecutive fresh observations of the same target package required before warning, from 1 to 10.

night_guard_max_enforcements_per_night.description: Maximum suspensions the guard performs per user per night, from 1 to 10.

night_guard_warning_cooldown_minutes.description: After a user release, the guard stays quiet for this long, from 5 to 1440 minutes.

night_guard_packages.description: Comma-separated app aliases or package names the night guard watches (video apps). Empty disables the guard even when the switch is on.

night_guard_exempt_packages.description: Comma-separated packages never touched by the night guard.

night_guard_private_only.description: Only send night-guard reminders to a recorded private chat session; never a group chat.

night_guard_dry_run.description: Dry-run mode observes, audits and sends the reminder but never suspends. Keep this on for the first deployment night.

night_guard_state_path.description: Persistent night-guard state: per-user phase, owned suspended packages and audit timestamps only. No tokens or message text.

enable_autonomy_scheduler.description: Let the phone plugin tick the companion bridge's care evaluation. It only decides when to ask; the bridge decides whether to send.

autonomy_check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between autonomy ticks. Each tick is skipped unless a fresh device heartbeat and a recorded private session exist.

care_status_path.description: Where to read the companion bridge's read-only care snapshot. Empty uses the default plugin data path; must match companion-context's care_status_path.

enable_task_execute.description: Execute granted phone tasks instead of only dry-running them. Keep false until the dry-run history looks right.

task_execute_allowed_actions.description: Comma-separated write actions the executor may run. A grant can still narrow this per run; listing an action here never overrides the grant.

task_step_timeout_seconds.description: Per-step timeout. A timed-out step is marked unknown and observed, never re-sent.

task_run_timeout_seconds.description: Total budget for one task run; remaining steps are skipped when it expires.

task_require_user_idle.description: Refuse to run a task while the phone is in active use (interactive screen, a foreground app that is neither a launcher nor the task's own target). Callers may override per request with allow_while_active.

task_approval_ttl_seconds.description: How long a proposed task waits for a human decision before it expires. A proposal alone never touches the phone.

screenshot_dir.description: Where captured screenshots are kept for auditing. Empty uses the plugin data directory; the newest 20 files are kept.

group_allowed_tools.description: Tools that may run in a group chat. Data tools (health, location, notifications, screenshots, audit, observe) stay private-only, so group members never see them.

task_runs_path.description: Persistent task run history (capped). Empty uses the default plugin data path.
